'''Roo-Roo Page's mother''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
She had a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] named [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo]] who was identified on the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] as a potential candidate for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] hired [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to abduct Force-adept children. Roo-Roo was one of four picked to be abducted by Bane. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had identified the youngling as a potential target and captured Bane when he attempted to take the child.<ref name="CotF" />
